description: David Wolfinger and Juan José Salazar González publish problem instances for pickup and delivery with split loads and transshipments. The instances were used in computational experiments for a branch-and-cut approach reported in the European Journal of Operational Research, volume 289, pages 470–484. They support optimisation and comparison of freight-routing methods that permit loads to be split and transferred. The native repository identifies University of La Laguna as the collection owner and links supporting article DOI 10.1016/j.ejor.2020.07.032. The dataset DOI identifies version 3, published in February 2023; earlier versions are listed separately within the same resource history. Mendeley provides public text-file access under CC BY 4.0 without a stated charge. No real-world geographic network, observation period, time resolution or complete internal field definitions are established by the metadata. File descriptors identify text instances but their contents were not inspected. This limitation prevents a claim that every field or experiment is immediately reproducible. Update frequency is not stated. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
